Lemon Skillet Chicken & Rice

Recipe Book: Weeknight

Servings: 4 servings

Total Time: 1 hour 5 minutes

Active Time: 20 minutes

Ingredients

  • 1 tablespoon olive oil

  • Chicken

  • 4 chicken thighs

  • 2 cloves garlic, minced

  • Rice:

  • 1 cup long-grain rice

  • 2 cups chicken broth

Directions

  1. 1. Heat the oil in a skillet.

  2. 2. Brown the chicken, 5 minutes a side.

  3. Finish

  4. Rice: stir in the rice and broth, then bake for 40 minutes.

  5. Serve:

  6. Method:

  7. Spoon the pan juices over the top.

Notes

Thighs stay juicier than breasts.

Keeps 3 days.
